mapper.select: SELECT md.*, c.name as customer_name, f.food_name, f.unit as food_unit, f.price as food_price, f.calories_per_unit as food_calories, u.real_name as caregiver_name, (md.quantity * f.price) as total_price, (md.quantity * f.calories_per_unit) as total_calories FROM meal_diaries md JOIN customers c ON md.customer_id = c.id JOIN foods f ON md.food_id = f.id LEFT JOIN users u ON md.caregiver_id = u.id WHERE md.customer_id = #{customerId} AND md.meal_date = #{mealDate} ORDER BY CASE md.meal_type WHEN '早餐' THEN 1 WHEN '午餐' THEN 2 WHEN '晚餐' THEN 3 WHEN '加餐' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, md.created_at

SELECT md.*, c.name as customer_name, f.food_name, u.real_name as caregiver_name, (md.quantity * f.price) as total_price, (md.quantity * f.calories_per_unit) as total_calories FROM meal_diaries md JOIN customers c ON md.customer_id = c.id JOIN foods f ON md.food_id = f.id LEFT JOIN users u ON md.caregiver_id = u.id WHERE md.customer_id = #{customerId} AND md.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY md.meal_date DESC, md.created_at DESC

SELECT SUM(md.quantity * f.calories_per_unit) as total_calories, SUM(md.quantity * f.protein_content) as total_protein, SUM(md.quantity * f.fat_content) as total_fat, SUM(md.quantity * f.carb_content) as total_carbs FROM meal_diaries md JOIN foods f ON md.food_id = f.id WHERE md.customer_id = #{customerId} AND md.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT SUM(md.quantity * f.price) as total_cost, COUNT(md.id) as total_records FROM meal_diaries md JOIN foods f ON md.food_id = f.id WHERE md.customer_id = #{customerId} AND md.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT md.*, f.food_name, (md.quantity * f.price) as total_price, (md.quantity * f.calories_per_unit) as total_calories FROM meal_diaries md JOIN foods f ON md.food_id = f.id WHERE md.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY md.meal_date DESC, md.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT meal_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(md.quantity * f.calories_per_unit) as total_calories, SUM(md.quantity * f.price) as total_cost FROM meal_diaries md JOIN foods f ON md.food_id = f.id WHERE md.customer_id = #{customerId} AND md.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY meal_type ORDER BY CASE meal_type WHEN '早餐' THEN 1 WHEN '午餐' THEN 2 WHEN '晚餐' THEN 3 WHEN '加餐' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT f.id as food_id, f.food_name, f.food_category, COUNT(md.id) as order_count, SUM(md.quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(md.quantity * f.price) as total_revenue FROM meal_diaries md JOIN foods f ON md.food_id = f.id WHERE md.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY f.id, f.food_name, f.food_category ORDER BY order_count DESC, total_quantity DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
